metaTitle: Private Event Ads Case Study: 72:1 ROAS | Button Up Media
metaDescription: Our 2025 Google Ads for private events and reservations at The Boathouse (72:1 ROAS, $30.58 per lead), The Odyssey (49:1 ROAS, 951 conversions) and Castaway.
ldHeadline: Private event Google Ads for The Boathouse, The Odyssey and Castaway
h1Sub: The Boathouse, The Odyssey and Castaway
answer: In 2025 we ran Google Ads for private events and reservations at The Boathouse, The Odyssey and Castaway. At The Boathouse, each $1 brought back about $72 in tracked value.

metrics.label: ROAS, The Boathouse
metrics.meaning: Every $1 of ads brought back about $72 in tracked private-event value, May to Dec 2025.

metrics.label: Per private-event lead, The Boathouse
metrics.meaning: This is what each event inquiry cost in ads. One booked event can be worth thousands of dollars.

metrics.label: ROAS, The Odyssey
metrics.meaning: Across dinner reservations and private events, about $49 came back for every $1 spent, Jun to Dec 2025.

paragraphs: A private event is a big booking, and each one that goes through can be worth thousands of dollars.
So we aimed the ads at people who were already planning an event and judged them on how many inquiries they brought in.

items.title: Show up when planners search by name
items.bodyHtml: We ran branded search ads for The Boathouse's private events. Branded search means the ad shows when someone searches for the restaurant by name, so the restaurant's own ad is the first thing an event planner sees.

items.title: Keep events and dinner separate
items.bodyHtml: At The Odyssey and at Castaway, we ran separate campaigns for dinner reservations and for private events, so each goal had its own budget and its own numbers.

items.title: Track every inquiry and booking
items.bodyHtml: We tracked every inquiry and booking, so each campaign is judged by the value it brings back.

items.title: Report the results every month
items.bodyHtml: Every month we report conversions, cost per conversion, conversion value and ROAS in plain numbers.

results.explainHtml: How to read these numbers: a conversion is one tracked action, like a private-event inquiry, a reservation or a call. ROAS (return on ad spend) compares the tracked value of those conversions with what the ads cost.
